faqs.question: What does HTLV 1 And 2 Virus Total Antibody by CLIA - Serum measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the antibodies to the Human T-Cell Lymphotropic Virus I and II (HTLV). These antibodies are produced by the immune system in response to an HTLV infection.

faqs.question: Why is HTLV Antibody Test done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose an HTLV infection • To monitor the course of an HTLV infection • To assess the risk of HTLV transmission from an infected mother to her baby • To screen people who are at high risk of HTLV infection, including people who have received blood transfusions or organ transplants, and intravenous drug users.

faqs.question: When is HTLV Antibody Test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is usually recommended when you have • signs and symptoms suggestive of HTLV infection such as inflammation in the spinal cord, nerve damage, or abnormal blood cell counts, • been in close contact with someone who has an HTLV infection, • received a blood transfusion or organ transplant before routine screening for HTLV began, or • shared needles or other injection equipment with someone who has an HTLV infection.

faqs.question: What if the results of the HTLV Antibody Test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results indicate that you have been exposed to an HTLV infection, but further tests may be needed to confirm or monitor the condition.

faqs.question: What to expect during the HTLV Antibody Test - Serum?
faqs.answer: This test involves taking a blood sample. A healthcare professional use a needle to collect the blood sample from your arm.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the HTLV Antibody Test?
faqs.answer: No special preparations are usually required for this test. You may be asked to avoid eating or drinking anything except water for several hours before the test. Inform your doctor if you have any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the HTLV Antibody Test?
faqs.answer: • HTLV DNA PCR: This test detects the genetic material of the virus in the blood, and is used in combination with antibody tests to confirm an HTLV infection. • CBC (Complete Blood Count) Test: This test measures different components of blood, including white blood cells, which can become abnormal in people with HTLV infections.

faqs.question: What is the HTLV 1 And 2 Virus Total Antibody by CLIA - Serum also known as?
faqs.answer: HTLV antibody testing or HTLV screening

faqs.question: What is HTLV Infection?
faqs.answer: HTLV infection is caused by Human T-Cell Lymphotropic Virus I and II, which can be transmitted through sexual contact, blood transfusions, or sharing of needles. The virus can cause various health conditions such as HTLV-associated myelopathy and adult T-cell leukaemia/lymphoma.
